text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the Kikuka Sho. Yaeno Muteki doesn't seem even a bit nervous. In fact, she's quite calm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All the same, something seems off about her when she runs into Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She seems to be struggling, lacking the competitive spirit she had at the Japanese Derby.
